newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up, confidence returning.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up, confidence returning.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move upwards when the market reopens after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said on Saturday.

"The market sentiment is getting strong as more and more small investors are returning after the government resumed credit facilities to them to ride over a lingering bearishness," said broker Mahbub Morshed.

Brokers said scrips in pharmaceutical and cement sectors might be in demand. The DSE all-share price index rose 18.81 points or 0.71 percent to 2,656.65 on turnover of 75.2 million taka on Thursday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
